name: Shirohime
source:
"It is as though my mind is clouded."

A girl with amnesia, clad in a pure-white kimono. According to Kurofude, she used to be one of the guides correcting distorted tales before she lost her memories. She can catch the bookworms that eat an illustrated book's words and extract the eaten words in the form of ink. She is modest and softhearted.

[From [url=https://adabanaitan.com/en/]ANIPLEX.EXE[/url]]
